error.invalid_url: Enter the full address including http or https, for example {example_url}.
error.not_ablago: No Ablago answers at this address, or it is too old. Use the address you open Ablago with in the browser.
error.redirect: The address redirects elsewhere. Use the address Ablago ends up at, usually one starting with https.
error.ssl_error: The certificate of Ablago is not trusted (expired, self-signed or for another name). Fix the certificate or turn off the certificate check.

data_description.api_key: Key of the level "counters only" from My account → Security → API keys. It can only read the counters.
data_description.url: The address you open Ablago with in the browser, for example {example_url}.

user.description: Every person adds their own entry. Create a key of the level "counters only" in Ablago under My account → Security → API keys. Afterwards, rename the device after the person, for example "Ablago · Lena".
user.title: Connect Ablago

invalid_auth.message: Ablago does not accept the API key.

ssl_error.message: The certificate of Ablago is not trusted.
